topic_word_translation: to fly a plane/to date someone much older

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Hey Michael, do you like to lái máy bay? I think I'm older than you, right?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Lái máy bay? Interesting, but I've never tried it. As for age... don't joke, Mira, I'm already 28 years old. But "lái máy bay" in Vietnam has another meaning, you know.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: What other meaning? I'm just curious because I'm learning to get an actual pilot's license. And I'm only 25, so you're older than me. I thích older people... they tend to be more mature.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Oh, sorry for misunderstanding. "Lái máy bay" in Vietnamese slang refers to younger people dating someone much older. But really? An actual pilot's license? I never thought Mira would thích things like that.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: You always misunderstand me! I told you long ago that I enjoy the feeling of freedom when flying. But... if you think I'm someone who likes to "lái máy bay" in that other sense, then maybe I'm not old enough for you.
